title: Redesign: Holographic hero, glass UI, responsive improvements
body:
This pull request contains a complete redesign of the portfolio to a premium futuristic professional style while preserving all original content (About, Experience, Skills, Services, Contact).

What I changed:
- Updated index.html: reorganized hero, improved SEO (title, meta description, Open Graph), preserved all text and links.
- Added styles.css: mobile-first responsive styles, holographic hero with glassmorphism, subtle rings, scanline, particles, floating info cards, glass cards across sections, timeline, skill chips, improved navigation (sticky, active indicator), and reduced-motion support.
- Added script.js: lightweight vanilla JS for typing effect, IntersectionObserver reveal, mobile nav toggle, desktop-only parallax, smooth scrolling fallback, and visibility-based animation reduction.

Notes and missing assets:
- assets/ashir-profile.jpg (portrait) and assets/Muhammad-Ashir-Hadi-CV.pdf (CV) are not present in the branch. I added assets/placeholder-readme.txt as a reminder.
- The site references these exact paths. Please upload the portrait and CV to the branch (redesign/holographic-hero) at the paths above.

Optimization (optional):
- After you upload the portrait I can optimize it (resize to 1200px long edge, progressive JPEG, quality ~75) and keep a backup as assets/ashir-profile-original.jpg. Reply with

when you upload and I will run the optimization and push the optimized file.

Testing checklist (what I will run after assets are added):
- Verify portrait displays and CV downloads from the hero and contact buttons.
- Test mobile widths: 360, 375, 390, 412, 430, 768, 1024 for overflow, overlaps, and hero scaling.
- Check console for JS errors.
- Check prefers-reduced-motion toggling.

If you want me to add a temporary image placeholder so you can preview immediately, reply with

and I will add a lightweight preview image to assets/ashir-profile.jpg.

Files changed: index.html, styles.css, script.js, assets/placeholder-readme.txt

Branch: redesign/holographic-hero
head: redesign/holographic-hero
